thread:
Leah Park: follow-up from the onboarding RFC — proposal: break intake into validator + scheduler + executor. keep validator super-fast (sync) so UX isn't blocked. scheduler handles queuing/priority, executor runs heavy benches.
Ravi Singh: why three pieces instead of a single service with worker threads?
Leah Park: separation gives independent scaling and clearer SLAs. validator needs low-latency, executor is bursty and expensive. also smaller blast radius on deploys.
Tom B.: ok but who owns the canonical state? worried about races where validator says accepted but scheduler drops the job. need durable reference.
Priya N.: keep a canonical manifest in object storage; validator writes a readonly ref (s3://...) and scheduler/exec read that. minimal proto manifest fields: version, model_id, artifact_list (path+sha256), compat_tier.
Jules: request: add "bench_seed_version" and a list of seed vector ids in the manifest. ensures reproducible bench runs.
Maya C.: also add normalized metadata step in validator to strip timestamps/random ids so benches don't see churn.
bench-bot: FYI: heavy bench concurrency is limited by GPU slots. last week median wait=9m.
Ravi Singh: on sync vs async validation: can validator return "accepted_degraded" and let runtime use fallback model until executor confirms?
Leah Park: yes. we should define three outcomes: accepted, rejected, accepted_degraded (needs bench). runtime then consults model registry for vetted_version or fallback.
Tom B.: we need clear contract for the "accepted_degraded" state: TTL, notif to owner, auto-disable if bench fails, etc.
Priya N.: suggest manifest include compat_tier: [experimental, standard, production]. production requires full bench pass, experimental can skip heavy bench. policy enforced by scheduler.
Jules: cross-service API: use gRPC + protobuf for manifest refs and job control. avoids json schema drift. create a thin shim for existing intake API to translate.
Maya C.: telemetry: create intake_id per request, store mapping intake_id -> bench_job_id in the KV store. bench logs bench_job_id, metrics, pass/fail. correlate with traces.
Ravi Singh: test plan: unit tests for validator lint+proto, integration test using a small golden-set (rng seeds fixed), load test that simulates intake spikes and bench backpressure. add chaos tests for KV outage.
Leah Park: rollout path: 1) proto + shim, 2) validator extracted behind feature flag, 3) scheduler + executor out-of-band, 4) golden-set verification, 5) canary + full rollout. each step small and reversible.
Tom B.: ops question: executor infra ownership? bench infra team or runtime infra? need SLA on job completion times to route decisions.
Priya N.: will loop in bench infra and runtime ops. propose autoscaling for executor, and a cheap fastpass bench (quantized inference) as emergency off-ramp when backlog high.
Jules: on determinism: add a manifest checksum field and require manifests be immutable. validator should reject manifests that change after creation.
Maya C.: add a "vetted_snapshot" field pointing to the last bench-passing artifact set. runtime can prefer vetted_snapshot for production traffic.
Leah Park: cost policy: scheduler should apply heuristics: skip heavy bench for low-cost experiments, require full bench for production-intent tags, sample percentage for early-stage models. store bench_budget estimate in intake request.
Ravi Singh: please include a small example proto in the RFC. something like:
```
message ManifestV1 {
  string manifest_version = 1;
  string model_id = 2;
  repeated Artifact artifacts = 3;
  string compat_tier = 4;
  repeated string bench_seed_ids = 5;
}
```

Priya N.: I'll author proto and lint rules today. will add sample CI to verify manifest immutability.
bench-bot: reminder: attach bench cost estimate when requesting GPU slots.
Tom B.: fallback semantics doc: runtime should check model_registry.vetted_snapshot, then compat_tier. if no vetted_snapshot and compat_tier!=production -> use fallback variant. I'll draft.
Leah Park: action items: Priya proto+lint, Ravi telemetry/KV mapping design, Tom fallback semantics, Jules seed vector list, Maya normalization rules. I'll synthesize into rollout doc.
Ravi Singh: ack. small note: include correlation headers for tracing: intake-id, parent-request-ts, source.
Priya N.: PR opened for proto in staging branch. pinging reviewers. :tada:
Leah Park: thanks everyone. coming back with a concise RFC follow-up next week.
